_README: ML30+ items validated against their DDO wiki page (source of truth). This file is BOTH the record and the resumable worklist for the wiki-validation loop: an item present here with `confirmed` set is skipped on re-runs. `affixes` documents the magnitude affixes read from the wiki `enhancements` field ({{Stat|value|type}} templates); `corrections` records any dataset change applied (wiki wins). `notes` capture procs/set/augment context. Method: MediaWiki query API via Claude-in-Chrome (ddowiki blocks plain fetch). Scope target: 1809 distinct ML30+ items. build_dataset stamps `wiki_confirmed` onto matching items from this file.

_meta.method: ddowiki MediaWiki query API (prop=revisions rvslots=main) via Claude-in-Chrome; parse the {{...}} templates in the `enhancements` field
_meta.policy: wiki is source of truth; on mismatch correct the dataset via the seed/pipeline and log it under `corrections` (never edit generated web/data/items.json)
